lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Ga2Zn2O8 (reduced formula YGaZnO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 14 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral Zn centers coordinated by four O neighbors (2 atoms, 1 orbit), while Ga and Y each show eight O neighbors in body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements (2 atoms each, 2 orbits). Corner-sharing between Zn tetrahedra and Ga/Y 8-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing among Ga polyhedra, forms a three-dimensional connected network.
